input.quote: 15. ASSIGNMENT OR TRANSFER. Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate.
input.rationale: Section 15 (p0080) is the only assignment provision; there is no change-of-control clause anywhere in the Agreement and Section 2's licence contains no separate non-transferability limit, so no Vendor right arises on our change of control. However, the clause fails the fallback on two material terms: it carves out only assignments to a "financially responsible affiliate" with no successor/M&A carve-out (walk-away territory for us on a merger or sale of substantially all assets), and the consent requirement for other assignments carries no reasonableness standard. Our edit sits at the fallback level: it retains the mutual structure and the existing affiliate exception verbatim, adds a successor carve-out on written notice, and qualifies consent as not to be unreasonably withheld. We did not press the preferred asymmetric position (Vendor consent-only, competitor bar, express change-of-control language), which would require restructuring the whole clause.

mappings.element: Both parties may assign to a successor.
A successor assignment requires written notice.

ops.oldText: 15. ASSIGNMENT OR TRANSFER. Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate.
ops.newText: 15. ASSIGNMENT OR TRANSFER. Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, which shall not be unreasonably withheld, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate or, upon written notice to the other party, to a successor in interest.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 15 bars assignment with only an affiliate exception, so we added a successor carve-out on written notice and a not-unreasonably-withheld standard for any other consent, in line with our fallback position.
proposal.summary: Add mutual successor-assignment carve-out on written notice and a not-unreasonably-withheld consent standard in Section 15.
